newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Perez Companc approves $300 mln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Perez Companc approves $300 mln bonds.

text.p: Argentine holding company Perez Companc said Monday its board had approved issuing seven-year bonds for up to $300 million January 30.
The bonds will pay nine percent annual interest and the money raised will be used for working capital, investment and/or refinancing other debt.
The bonds will be the fourth in series issued under Perez Companc's global bond program and will be listed on the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange and on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.
The issue organizer will be Morgan Stanley and Co. Citibank International Plc is the arranger of the bond program.
